description: Qualitative validation targets for a swept-tapered wing with ONERA M6 planform. The numerical values here are RANGES typical of a well-posed RANS simulation at the listed conditions on a 500k-1M cell mesh — NOT AGARD AR-138 experimental data points. Quantitative AGARD comparison requires (a) the real ONERA section (this case uses NACA 0010 as a workshop-friendly proxy) and (b) digitized AGARD Cp ordinates at the six standard wing stations. Pointers to obtain both are in cases/examples/onera-m6/reference/README.md.

convention.geometry: ONERA M6 planform: root chord = 1, tip chord = 0.5626, semi-span = 1.4846, LE sweep = 30 deg. Section: NACA 0010 (workshop proxy, not the real M6 section).
convention.coefficients: Cl, Cd are 3-D wing coefficients (full-span lift / drag normalized by 0.5 * rho * U_inf^2 * S_ref). S_ref is the wing planform area (the half-wing's area, doubled if a symmetry plane is used).

subsonic_case.notes: Subsonic, kOmegaSST, incompressible (simpleFoam). ~500k cells, ~30 min on 4 cores. The real ONERA M6 transonic case (M=0.84, alpha=3.06 deg) requires a compressible solver and finer near-shock refinement; included as an advanced variant — see scenarios/onera-m6.yaml.

qualitative_targets.rationale: A swept-tapered wing of this aspect ratio at alpha = 5 deg subsonic should produce a Cl in this band. Within-range is necessary but not sufficient; pair with the Cp suction-peak check below.
Total Cd including induced drag from finite span. Workshop-mesh resolution will vary results; the range is intentionally wide.
On a subsonic conventional symmetric airfoil at moderate alpha, the upper-surface suction peak sits very near the leading edge.
Loose range covering both the subsonic case (~ -1.5) and the transonic case (~ -2.0 just ahead of the shock). Inspect the magnitude qualitatively against expected boundary-layer behavior.

primary_citation: Schmitt, V. & Charpin, F. (1979). Pressure Distributions on the ONERA-M6-Wing at Transonic Mach Numbers. AGARD AR-138, Experimental Data Base for Computer Program Assessment.
data_provenance: Hand-authored qualitative ranges based on RANS-CFD experience for this planform. NOT digitized experimental data. To compare quantitatively against AGARD AR-138 Cp ordinates at the six standard wing stations (y/b = 0.20, 0.44, 0.65, 0.80, 0.90, 0.95), download the AGARD report or use the NASA Turbulence Modeling Resource compilation at https://tmbwg.github.io/turbmodels/onerawingnumerics_val.html — and replace the NACA 0010 section in cases/examples/onera-m6/geometry/generate_m6_wing.py with the real ONERA M6 ordinates from the same source.
